أغرورق (form XII)
# أَغْرَوْرِقُ (ʔaḡrawriqu) /ʔaɣ.raw.ri.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِغْرَوْرَقَ (iḡrawraqa)
# أَغْرَوْرِقَ (ʔaḡrawriqa) /ʔaɣ.raw.ri.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِغْرَوْرَقَ (iḡrawraqa)
# أَغْرَوْرِقْ (ʔaḡrawriq) /ʔaɣ.raw.riq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِغْرَوْرَقَ (iḡrawraqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
